environment.description: Terraform provider deployed as a custom provider plugin running on a self-hosted Terraform Enterprise instance. The PostgreSQL backend (v14.2) has tenant_secrets table with no row-level security policies enabled. The provider's HTTP auth endpoint is exposed on an internal network (10.0.0.0/16) with no rate limiting. Database role used is 'terraform_app' which is a superuser with BYPASSRLS privilege. Network latency is <0.1ms (same-AZ deployment), making timing measurements highly reliable.
